function.name: get_collectables_in_season

function.name: game_score_highest
function.description: Retrieve the highest score achieved by any player in a specific game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the online game.

platform.description: The platform where the game is played, e.g. PC, Xbox, Playstation

region.description: The geographic region of the player. Defaults to 'Global'

function.name: lawsuit_details_find
function.description: Find details of lawsuits involving a specific company from a given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: calculate_binomial_probability
function.description: Calculates the binomial probability given the number of trials, successes and the probability of success on an individual trial. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

number_of_successes.description: The desired number of successful outcomes.

probability_of_success.description: The probability of a successful outcome on any given trial. This is a float type value.
